alternatives.option: A: Roadmap slices as K9 cards
alternatives.impact: Tight coupling to K9 planner import; slices would require a board and import_id even for infrastructure work. Rejected because R3 slices are roadmap-defined, not Kanban-card-defined.
Race conditions on NFS; no atomic check-and-set; harder to debug. SQLite lease is atomic within BEGIN IMMEDIATE and consistent with existing K9 pattern.

alternatives.option: C: Supervisor state embedded in mission_missions.state_json
alternatives.impact: Would bloat the R1 schema with supervisor-specific fields. Separate table keeps concerns clean and allows independent evolution.

key_architectural_choices: Slices are roadmap-defined objects (not K9 cards)
Lease via SQLite table with TTL (not external mutex)
Supervisor state in separate table (not embedded in mission_state)
One supervisor per mission enforced by lease
